glosses: regimen (remedy intended to produce beneficial effects)
scheme (systematic plan of future action) (e.g. a pension scheme, an aid scheme, a loan scheme)

examples.text: Tengo que perder peso, así que me voy a poner a régimen.
examples.en: I have to lose weight, so I'm going on a diet.

examples.text: El médico me aconsejó que me pusiera a régimen.
examples.en: The doctor advised me that I should go on a diet.
